description: Partner pack for Farcaster — decentralized social protocol on OP + Base, Frames for inline dApps, Warps for tipping. Biases toward social+crypto fusion apps, frame-based mini-apps, and agent accounts.

defaults.headline: Build on Farcaster — social + Frames + mini-apps
defaults.subheadline: Hubs for content, Frames for inline dApps, Base-native wallet. Ship a mini-app the feed can render without leaving the client.

buildHints.whenToUse: Prompt mentions Farcaster, Warpcast, Frames, Mini Apps, FID, or Hub APIs. Also social+onchain hybrid flows where cast context matters.
firstSteps: For reading casts/users, use Neynar (neynar.com) or Pinata Hub — the protocol-level Hub API is low-level; Neynar gives indexed search, reactions, feeds.
For Frames v2 / Mini Apps, return the required meta tags from your Next.js route; use `@farcaster/frame-sdk` client-side. Spec: https://miniapps.farcaster.xyz.
Auth via SIWF (Sign-In With Farcaster) — the browser-extension-less flow uses QR code + AuthKit (`@farcaster/auth-kit`).
gotchas: Hubs are eventually-consistent — a cast might not appear on every Hub for 5-30s. For time-critical flows (airdrops by FID), double-check via Neynar with a fallback Hub.
Frames/Mini Apps run inside the client (Warpcast/Base) iframe — window.parent is gated. Treat the Frame API as the sole source of truth for user identity, not window.*.
FID is a uint32; don't persist as a string without a comment. Custody address (EVM) and FID are separate — link via the IdRegistry contract on Optimism.
